items.caption: A modern redraw of a received seal-script form of 笑. Transmitted accounts disagree over whether the graph pairs 竹 with 犬 or with 夭, and the form does not establish its origin.
items.alt: Seal-script-style 笑, with two short strokes above a larger curved form.
items.selection_reason: It gives a visual example of the received seal-script tradition. Its modern redraw status and the conflicting transmitted analyses limit what it shows about the graph’s early history.

limitations.text: This is a modern redraw, not an ancient artifact image. Reported early manuscript forms are analyzed as 艸 above 犬, but their exact shapes and component roles remain unsettled; this image cannot resolve how they relate to the received forms.
